mira (sec-eng): FYI customers in eu-west reporting intermittent SAML SSO failures: UI shows 500 'decrypt failed'.

ben (infra-kms): Any KMS rotations or key ops this window? I rotated idp-wrap v7 at 04:12 UTC earlier.

mira (sec-eng): Logs show JWE parse rejects: 'unsupported header alg "A256GCM"' for some assertions but KMS audit shows decrypt succeeded for the same req id.

lina (identity): Can you paste the log lines and tenant ids (obfuscated)? Also did the SP metadata change?

mira (sec-eng): snippet:

level=error svc=sp-decrypt tenant=tenant-bx2 err="jwe: unsupported header alg 'A256GCM'" req=tx-01
level=info svc=kms tenant=tenant-bx2 action=Decrypt key=idp-wrap key_version=7 status=ok req=tx-01

mira (sec-eng): So sp-decrypt parser rejects before or after KMS engagement in a weird way.

ben (infra-kms): We bumped the jose dependency in sp-decrypt last week; it tightened header validation and removed a legacy fallback for A256GCMKW variants. That could explain it.

noah (sre): We also applied a role tightening yesterday (minimal-service-account). I'll confirm SP pod SA still has kms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToDecrypt.

lina (identity): Customer says IdP unchanged. Noted that failing tenants use older connector firmware (ES-2). Connector translation might be emitting slightly different JWE headers.

mira (sec-eng): Mitigation proposal: tenant-gated permissive header fallback in sp-decrypt to accept A256GCM header if key wrap present. Add debug header logging (masking keys). Gate rollout to EU canary.

ben (infra-kms): I can author a small patch to accept that header variant temporarily and add debug logs. Will open PR.

noah (sre): I'll validate RBAC meanwhile. If perms OK, deploy canary to 3 pods in eu-west-1 and watch KMS audit and parse metrics. deploy-bot?

deploy-bot: Canary deploy initiated for tag canary/jwe-header-fallback -> 3 pods in eu-west-1. Health checks at +5m and +15m.

mira (sec-eng): Also request adding parse_failure metric/alert (>10/min per region) to catch future JWE parse rejects. Lina to file eval ticket for SSO observability.

lina (identity): Will file the ticket and contact affected customers for redacted assertions and connector versions.

ben (infra-kms): PR: https://git.internal/redwood/sp-decrypt/pull/901 (header fallback + header debug logs, tenant gate). Includes repro steps.

noah (sre): RBAC check: SP SA has required KMS perms, no changes detected.

mira (sec-eng): Canary reduced errors for tenant-bx2. Plan: 1) ship hotfix for parser canonicalization, 2) add parse_failure metric & alert, 3) run postmortem and engage connector owners. Owners: ben->patch/release, lina->customer comms + postmortem, noah->monitoring, mira->incident writeup. I'll update when postmortem draft posted. :white_check_mark:
